name: effect-neon-flicker
title: Neon Flicker
description: Biển neon bật lên chập chờn theo từng nấc sáng tối không đều rồi sáng ổn định.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s it takes to come on (0.9): held steps 20 / 100 / 35 / 100 / 55 / 100 %
options.lit: the lit layer (the dim tube stays under it)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Neon sign turns on over 900 ms: opacity holds in steps (no tween) at 20 % from 0, 100 % from 9 %, 35 % from 14 %, 100 % from 22 %, 55 % from 31 %, 100 % from 42 % on. Lit tube = 3 px stroke with a 16 px glow (the frame outline lights with the text) plus a soft radial wash (16 % opacity) behind; the unlit tube stays visible as a dim outline. Params: duration (0.9 s) · steps: các nấc (20 / 100 / 35 / 100 / 55 / 100 %) · glow (16 px) · color.
moworks.titleVi: Đèn neon chập chờn rồi sáng hẳn
